description: Rug-check a Solana token mint from public RPC data: mint and freeze authority status, metadata mutability (Metaplex update authority / isMutable or Token-2022 metadata), Token-2022 extensions (transfer fee, permanent delegate, transfer hook, pausable, default-frozen), top-holder concentration excluding pools and the bonding curve where identifiable, pump.fun curve status, PumpSwap LP burn share, and copycats of major tokens like USDC. Lists what it couldn't determine. Not an audit. Costs $0.005.
name: solana_token_check
